messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: possible billing/metering anomaly detected for hosted API (token_count drift + delayed usage reports). Pager triggered (sev-2). Graph: https://grafana.redwood/shot/abc123 :rotating_light:

emma_oncall: saw the page, looking now. which pipeline is alerting?

raj_sre: metrics show a divergence between raw token_emitted counter and billed_tokens counter starting ~2026-03-15T02:10Z. billed_tokens stuck, raw increasing.

chen_platform: that's the metering aggregator (meter-consumer) in k8s cluster eu-west-1. Last deploy by @deploy-bot at 01:58Z.

maria_billing: finance is getting overage flags for a handful of customers — they see usage spikes but invoices/usage reports haven't updated. Customers pinging support.

olivia_support: three customer threads opened in the last 30m. Customers see quota warnings even though actual token use is higher. Escalating.

emma_oncall: first things first: is this a counting drift (i.e., double counting) or a delayed export? Raj, can you check consumer offsets and commit lag?

raj_sre: tailing the consumer logs now. get offsets:
```
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group meter-consumer --describe
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering        0          14234567        14234567        0
metering        1          14230012        14230020        8
metering        2          14233200        14235000        1800
```

raj_sre: partition 2 lagging (~1800 messages). consumer pod `meter-consumer-2` restarted at 02:09Z per kube events. looks like transient restart -> backlog.

chen_platform: pod restart reason: OOMKilled. recent heap growth in metering service after latest compile. we pushed a small memory-bound change in the worker.

emma_oncall: that explains delay, but what about token_count drift (billed_tokens lower than actual)? If consumer reprocessed messages maybe dedupe idempotency broke?

raj_sre: check shows duplicate suppression uses a sliding window keyed by request_id stored in redis. Redis TTL on that keyspace got evicted around 02:05Z (we had eviction pressure). When the consumer restarted it reprocessed and dedupe failed -> some messages skipped downstream aggregator.

maria_billing: so customers may be underbilled temporarily? The system shows lower billed_tokens than actual events. Are we safe to backfill? Any risk of double billing later?

emma_oncall: plan: 1) stabilize consumer (increase pod memory, restart with new env to avoid OOM) 2) pause automatic invoice generation for affected window 3) run a replay/backfill from raw event archive into billing pipeline with a safe dedupe mode 4) notify customers and CS.

chen_platform: bumping memory and redeploying now. command:
```
kubectl set resources deploy/meter-consumer -n prod --limits=memory=2Gi --requests=1Gi
kubectl rollout restart deploy/meter-consumer -n prod
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started for deploy/meter-consumer by chen_platform at 02:27Z. New replica set rs-56b starting pods.

raj_sre: monitoring consumer lag. now catching up: partition 2 lag reduced to 1200 -> 300 -> 0 over 6 minutes.

maria_billing: I've paused scheduled invoice emission for the affected account cohort (batch window 02:00-03:30Z) and set a hold flag to avoid auto-charges. Will coordinate manual review.

olivia_support: sending preliminary note to impacted customers: short message explaining delayed usage reporting and that charges will be reviewed. draft: "We're investigating a metering delay affecting some usage displays and invoices. No unexpected charges will be posted while we investigate. We'll follow up with corrected reports."

emma_oncall: good. Raj/Chen, after backlog drains, please run the backfill in read-only mode first and produce a diff of computed billed_tokens vs current billing DB. Use the replay tool: `scripts/replay_metering --start=2026-03-15T02:00Z --end=2026-03-15T03:30Z --dry-run`. Attach diffs in this thread.

raj_sre: dry-run complete. summary: dry-run reports +1.2M tokens across 47 customers, discrepancy concentrated on three large customers. Sample output:
```
customer-id, current_billed, replay_billed, delta
cust_122,  8,200,000, 9,100,000, +900,000
cust_334,  2,100,000, 2,300,000, +200,000
cust_778,  500,000,  520,000,    +20,000
```

maria_billing: ok that's manageable. we'll prepare adjusted usage reports and credit any erroneous quota/overage flags. Need sign-off from finance lead on credits > $5k. I'll queue it.

emma_oncall: mitigation checklist so far: stabilize consumer (done), pause invoice emission (done), dry-run backfill (done). Next: perform live backfill, monitor for double-counting, then re-enable invoice flow + postmortem.

chen_platform: starting live backfill now with dedupe strict: `scripts/replay_metering --start=... --end=... --dedupe=redis-lock --commit`

raj_sre: backfill running. tailing logs show processed messages and dedupe hits. No errors so far. Throughput ~200k msgs/min. ETA ~8m.

olivia_support: continuing to update customers. CS asking for ETA to resolution to share; currently saying "within the hour".

deploy-bot: meter-consumer rollout successful. All pods at 3/3 ready.

raj_sre: backfill finished at 02:47Z. Commit summary: +1,230,546 tokens applied. No signs of double-counting in billing DB; dedupe checks passed.

maria_billing: applied corrections to usage reports and cleared holds for manual one-off review. Will send corrected statements and any credits by EOD.

emma_oncall: excellent. final actions: 1) update status page with root cause: metering consumer OOM + redis eviction -> delayed processing and missing dedupe window 2) create postmortem ticket (ENG-INC-2026-0315) with timeline and remediation: increase memory, set redis eviction alarms, add consumer liveness check to restart gracefully, and add billing hold auto-flag on detected drift > 0.5% in near real-time. 3) notify finance/sales of customers with >$5k corrections.

raj_sre: opened ENG-INC-2026-0315: https://redwood.atlassian/ENG-INC-2026-0315 with initial notes and links to logs/graphs.

maria_billing: tagging finance lead @mike_finance for sign-off on credits.

emma_oncall: thanks everyone. moving thread to incident follow-up. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:
